steps.content: [Guest room]
You return to your room, glancing out the open window toward Vautour Bleu's apartment across the way.

The datura flowers on her balcony seem even more vibrant. Behind the blinds, you hear intermittent sounds of running water. A misty vapor drifts your way, carrying with it the scent of soap mingled with a faint trace of tobacco.
The scent is unmistakable. Just moments ago, this very fragrance was mere inches away from your face.

She noticed your shackles, yet said nothing. She's aware of the monster, but shies away from mentioning it, even concealing its presence. She knows you're investigating the Mania contamination, yet still allows you to stay...

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Miss Vautour Bleu? Ah, everyone here respects her, worships her, even. After all, it's thanks to her that we got to meet each other.

steps.speaker: Outland Affairs Bureau
steps.content: But criminals always find a sneaky way in. Though immigration policies may have toughened, the WhiteSands trade routes remain active. After all, smuggling people is far more lucrative than smuggling goods.

steps.speaker: Primrose
steps.content: Miss Vautour Bleu took me under her wing. Thanks to her, I have work here in Désir and can save up for my journey to DisCity. I'll always be grateful for her kindness!

steps.speaker: Liam
steps.content: This is the only place where I can hear from Mom and wait for her to come and get me. Miss Vautour Bleu has promised to help me! She'll hide me in one of the caravan's cargo boxes when it's time. Those DisCity border guards won't even notice!

steps.speaker: Outland Affairs Bureau
steps.content: That's when Vautour Bleu seized control of the ruins. Using dubious financial tactics, she gathered a group of penniless, undocumented immigrants dreaming of instant success in DisCity, and established her dominion over Désir.

steps.speaker: Alba
steps.content: Who do you think gave me the chance to dance here? Do you have any idea how much it costs to enter a beauty pageant in DisCity? Everything in Désir belongs to Vautour Bleu. Yes, I'm working my tail off for her, but without her, I wouldn't even dare to dream about anything.

steps.speaker: Juan
steps.content: You don't trust Vautour Bleu, you wouldn't stay in Désir. Look, I ain't gonna say yes to everything she does, but I gotta say... she's good people.

steps.speaker: Outland Affairs Bureau
steps.content: For DisCity's sake, any threat in WhiteSands must be snuffed out before it hits us.

You mull over their conflicting words of Vautour Bleu and still can't piece together a coherent picture. Is she an unscrupulous smuggler? A philanthropist? A savior? Or perhaps the real culprit leaving Mania to spread unchecked?

You've run countless missions. You know all too well that words may be wrong but eyes never lie. No matter what others say of Vautour Bleu, there's one thing for certain: she is deliberately hiding the existence of the monsters.

steps.speaker: Communications
steps.content:
█ Contamination is detected in Désir; emotional condensation could be its source. It could possibly threaten the townsfolk. However, there's a significant discrepancy between the Mania level I've observed and the M-value anomalies recorded. I suspect an even larger-scale contamination concealed in this place.

█ Investigation was interrupted by Vautour Bleu. My cover may have been compromised. FAC should prepare for my retreat and, if necessary, emergency civilian rescue.

steps.speaker: Communications
steps.content:
█ In addition, I'll need the Outland Affairs Bureau to verify the following individuals, see if they have recorded activities within DisCity:

█ Sheila, 16 yoa female, Velvet Valley.
Darcy, 23 yoa male, Visserno Town...

steps.speaker: Communications
steps.content: █ One more, Nightingale, there's something I want you to look into...
[Vibrating white flash]
The instant you hit send, a noise outside the window startles you. In a flash, you stash away your communication device and duck behind the gauze curtains.
Through the sheer white curtains, you make out a hazy silhouette behind the blinds of the opposite room.
The figure seems oblivious to your presence. The sounds of running water have long ceased, replaced by the faint rustle of curtains, the chirping of insects, and your own muffled breathing.
You focus all your attention on observing the figure's every movement, but nothing seems to be happening.
The window facing you remains half-open, from which a delicate, misty scent of soap wafts through the air before fading away.
